title: Transfer of compactness to the pro-étale localizing category
statement:
Fix the standing finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite-type $k$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and a finite commutative ring $A$ with $\ell^rA=0$ for some $r\ge0$. Give $A$ the discrete topology. Use the unbounded derived category $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ of module objects over the pulled-back condensed coefficient ring $A_X$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\Dctf(X,A)$ be its full subcategory of bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and let $\mathcal L=\Loc(\Dctf(X,A))$ be the full replete triangulated, small-coproduct-closed hull with ambient coproducts [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Then every $C\in\Dctf(X,A)$ is compact in $\mathcal L$: for every small family $(K_s)_{s\in S}$ of objects of $\mathcal L$, the canonical map
$$\bigoplus_{s\in S}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal L}(C,K_s)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal L}\!\left(C,\bigoplus_{s\in S}K_s\right)$$
is bijective [def-pc-compact-object], with smallness relative to [def-weil-size-convention].

proof.text: Use the finite-field cardinality to obtain CharP D.k D.p and IsAlgClosed D.k, hence invertibility of ell. The annihilation hypothesis implies nilpotence of ell in ULift A. Finite type over the field makes X locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, hence Noetherian. Choose eR by the finite-discrete condensed-ring comparison.

Let L be derived comparisonUpperStar, R derived finiteComparisonRealization and F=L followed by R. The finite coefficient realization is an equivalence. unboundedSiteComparison and the derived composition isomorphism give full faithfulness and coproduct preservation of L; reflection through that equivalence removes finiteCoefficientRealization. Thus F is fully faithful, exact, and preserves coproducts.
finiteDiscreteCtfOrigin gives a bounded constructible finite-Tor etale antecedent for each generator, with its comparison isomorphism. The etale compactness theorem makes the antecedent of C compact.

The essential image of F is triangulated and replete by full faithfulness and exactness. It is closed under small coproducts by preservation. For every larger existing coproduct, the projection-inclusion endomorphisms show that its nonzero summands form a small subtype; omitting zero summands and shrinking gives the same colimit point, proving closure under all existing coproducts. The essential image contains the generators by finiteDiscreteCtfOrigin. Evaluate the defining intersection localizingClosureProEtale on that essential image to obtain all closure objects. The statement supplies the ambient coproduct used in its conclusion.

For a small family choose antecedents M_i and isomorphisms F M_i = E_i. Construct mutually inverse coproduct comparison maps by the universal properties. The resulting Hom bijections and direct-sum map intertwine the canonical compactness maps: verify on each summand using functoriality and the coproduct component equation. Transfer the etale bijectivity.

For an arbitrary indexing universe, any existing coproduct has a small set of nonzero summands: i maps injectively to its projection-inclusion idempotent endomorphism, since comparing components distinguishes two nonzero summands. Shrink that subtype to the Hom universe, omit zero summands, and show the same cofan is a coproduct. The small-family surjectivity then gives the original surjectivity. Independently, projection maps recover every finite-support component, proving injectivity for every family. This also covers empty families, empty schemes and zero rings.

proof_origin.place: Both paragraphs and displayed Hom calculation, with the explicit essential-image proof and arbitrary-universe coproduct reduction.
